messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Heartburn can mimic early symptoms of a heart attack.
Get emergency medical help if you have chest pain that spreads to your jaw or shoulder and you feel anxious or light-headed.
You should not use Pantoprazole if:
you also take medicine that contains rilpivirine (Edurant, Complera, Juluca, Odefsey);
if you had breathing problems, kidney problems, or a severe allergic reaction after taking pantoprazole in the past; or
you are allergic to pantoprazole or similar medicines (lansoprazole, omeprazole, Nexium, Prevacid, Prilosec, and others).
Tell your doctor if you have ever had:
low levels of magnesium, calcium, or potassium in your blood;
lupus; or
osteoporosis or low bone mineral density.
You may be more likely to have a broken bone while using pantoprazole long-term or more than once per day.
Talk with your doctor about ways to keep your bones healthy, especially if you are an adult over 50.
This medicine may harm an unborn baby.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant.
Pantoprazole can pass into breast milk.
Triplet: ["Pantoprazole", "has risk of", "increased likelihood of broken bone"]

The relation 'has risk of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug may increase the risk of the adverse outcome or complication specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
C. 'has side effect more likely in': The subject drug is more likely to cause the specified adverse effect or reaction in the population or group specified by the object entity.
D. 'has side effect frequency': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect specified by the object entity with the frequency indicated.
E. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
